statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
These belts... look closely at the leather, adventurer. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
narrative.objectives: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Arynia investigates the amulets.>Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.I will inform my superiors of this at once.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
